_forkBlock: Pinned so the venue does not drift between rehearsal and demo. F1 §1.
_aqua: AquaRouter = Aqua + Simulator + Multicall + Rescuable. Canonical across 12 chains. Source: 1inch/aqua README. There is no swap() on this — swaps go through the SwapVM router below. F1 §3.
_swapVMRouter: CONFIRMED AquaSwapVMRouter v1.0.0 via eip712Domain(), asserted in contracts/test/ForkVenue.t.sol. The deployed version is NOT the tip of 1inch/swap-vm master — the quote() ABI and the instruction set both differ. Its source IS published: verified on Sourcify (exact_match). Build against the Sourcify-verified deployed source, never against master.
_tokens: Native USDC (6dp) and WETH (18dp) on Base. Sorted WETH < USDC, which is the tokenA/tokenB order MakerTraits requires. Addresses only — contracts/test/ForkVenue.t.sol parses .tokens.<SYMBOL> as an address, so keep this a flat map.
_tokenList: Same tokens as above with display metadata for the app's token picker (packages/app/src/lib/tokens.ts). Keep the two in sync.
